title: negative claims in a plan are executed by the audit, not taken on trust
desc:
"Nothing else calls charge()" passes today by citing a real line (def charge(total):) -- the quote is true and the claim is not checked. Absence and blast-radius claims are the most expensive hallucination class.

ACCEPTANCE:
- evidence[] accepts kind: "absence" with search: {pattern, paths?, allow?} instead of file/line/quote
- sdd audit runs the search itself (git grep -n, fixed-string by default, bounded output, tracked files only) and fails when a match exists outside allow
- the pattern is validated and bounded (length, no shell); the command the audit ran is recorded in audit.json
- plan-change references/sdd.md documents the kind; code-search.md points blast-radius claims at it
- regression tests: a false absence claim fails, a true one passes, an allowed caller passes
